name: ModelVariant98_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant98_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a blinking six-blade fan grows on a joint, a textured 9x9 grid spins under the opponent, and rising sparks and spinning rings stream from it); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request and packs six texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the sparks start, 4 while they are emitted, 1 on the first frame after that (0 later) and 2 at the end; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-115 and 245 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
